data.question: I'm having issues starting my dehumidifier.
data.answer:
• Ensure the plug is pushed completely into the outlet. Appliances should be plugged directly into a wall outlet.
• The humidity level has already reached the pre-set level.
• Ensure the bucket is empty and that it is in the proper position.
• Check to see if your home’s circuit breaker or fuse is working properly.
• If there was a power failure, please allow 3 minutes for the unit to continue working as normal.

data.question: The dehumidifier is not drying the air as it should.
data.answer:
• Please allow at least 24 hours to reach desired humidity level.
• Make sure there are no curtains, blinds, or furniture blocking the air intake.
• The air filter may be dirty. We recommend cleaning it and trying again once it has completely dried.
• Ensure all doors and windows are closed properly and the unit is away from a dryer leaking moisture.
• This model is designed to operate in temperatures above 41 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.question: The Filter LED is on and the filter has been cleaned.
data.answer: • The filter LED turns on as a reminder to check and clean the filter if necessary.  To turn it off hold down the button for a couple of seconds.
